id.instruksi: Tokoh mau bermain di taman. Dengarkan apa yang akan ia lakukan, lalu sentuh bagian tubuh yang bekerja lebih dulu.
id.t-1: Tokoh mau lompat tali. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-2: Tokoh mau berlari mengejar layang-layang. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-3: Tokoh mau naik tangga perosotan satu per satu. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-4: Tokoh mau menarik napas dalam sebelum bernyanyi. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-5: Tokoh mau menghirup wangi bunga dalam-dalam. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-6: Tokoh mau meniup kincir angin kertas. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-7: Tokoh mau mendorong ayunan teman dengan tangan. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-8: Tokoh mau bergelantungan di palang taman. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-9: Tokoh mau mengangkat ember berisi pasir. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-10: Tokoh mau menghitung bunga di taman. Bagian mana yang bekerja?
id.t-11: Tokoh mau mengingat jalan pulang dari taman. Bagian mana yang bekerja?

en.instruksi: The character wants to play in the park. Listen to what it will do, then touch the body part that works first.
en.t-1: The character wants to skip rope. Which part works?
en.t-2: The character wants to run after a kite. Which part works?
en.t-3: The character wants to climb the slide steps one by one. Which part works?
en.t-4: The character wants to take a deep breath before singing. Which part works?
en.t-5: The character wants to breathe in a flower's smell deeply. Which part works?
en.t-6: The character wants to blow a paper pinwheel. Which part works?
en.t-7: The character wants to push a friend's swing with its hands. Which part works?
en.t-8: The character wants to hang from the monkey bars. Which part works?
en.t-9: The character wants to lift a bucket of sand. Which part works?
en.t-10: The character wants to count the flowers in the park. Which part works?
en.t-11: The character wants to remember the way home from the park. Which part works?
